Name: dizzi Skimpy 11 Sprites Force 1.0.0
Author: dizziRD
Description: Forces the Skimpy VN sprites on the 11 bachelors and bachelorettes in every season, downscaling the source sheets to the vanilla sprite grid so the proportions stay correct.
